title: Fix Rust borrow checker errors by narrowing borrow scopes before cloning
applies_when: cargo check reports borrow checker errors such as E0499, E0502, or E0382
The same compiler error persists after an attempted local edit
failure_signals: The model proposes cloning before identifying the active borrow
The model edits several functions before running cargo check
A ToolResult repeats the same compiler error after an edit
preconditions: Read the complete function that owns the failing borrow
Identify where the immutable and mutable borrows overlap
method_steps: Find the smallest scope that needs the immutable borrow
Move dependent calculations before the mutable borrow starts
Prefer a local temporary variable over cloning owned state
Apply one minimal edit and run cargo check before further changes
verification: Run the closest unit test if the module already has one
avoid: Do not add clone as the first fix
Do not rewrite public APIs unless the local scope change cannot work
Do not edit unrelated files while the compiler error is still unresolved
escalate_if: The same borrow checker error remains after two verified minimal edits
The fix requires changing public API or data ownership across modules

evidence.notes: Paper 2 pilot ceiling condition: human-authored procedural memory.
